name: OrdersPreviewProductOutput
description: The returned information of the product selected

bundle.description: The bundle ID of the product comprising of value added products.

deal.description: This specifies the deal tagging for the product.

discount_percentage.description: Discount percentage of the applied deal.

public_price.description: Original price of this product, before applying any discounts.

tags.description: The tags of all the applied deals.

third_party.description: Boolean value is "true" if the product is facilitated by a Booking.com partner company and "false" otherwise.

type.description: Type of inventory - either net or sell rates.

cancellation.description: The cancellation policy schedule for this product.

from.description: The time from which this cancellation fee applies. `now` means from booking time.

meal_plan.description: The meal plan policy for this product.

meals.description: The meals included in the meal plan.

plan.description: The meal plan included in this product.

price.description: The price components of this product. 'base' and 'extra_charges' are returned only when explicitly requested (via 'extras=extra_charges').

base.description: The base price. It does not include any extra charges.

chargeable_online.description: The price that will be charged by Booking.com when online payments are used. This field does not apply to the "pay_at_the_property" timing.

extra_charges.description: The charge breakdown. Includes taxes and fees.

conditional.description: Charges that might apply under a specific condition.

items.description: Charges that might apply under a specific condition.

charge.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation charge type. Examples of charges are: VAT, City Tax, etc. The full list can be obtained by calling accommodations/constants.

condition.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies the condition ID. Find the full list in the Pricing guidelines.

mode.description: The mode of this charge. Determines how the price is calculated.

percentage.description: The percentage of 'base' that this charge amounts to. Only applicable when 'mode' is 'percentage'.

total_amount.description: The total price for this charge.

unit_amount.description: The price per unit for this charge. Only applicable when 'mode' is 'per_day', 'per_night', 'per_person_per_day', 'per_person_per_night', or 'per_person_per_stay'.

non_conditional.description: All non-conditional charges that will necessarily be paid

items.description: All non-conditional charges that will necessarily be paid

charge.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation charge type. Examples of charges are: VAT, City Tax, etc. The full list can be obtained by calling accommodations/constants.

chargeable_online.description: Whether this charge is chargeable online or not. Not applicable to "pay_at_the_property" timing.

mode.description: The mode of this charge. Determines how the price is calculated.

percentage.description: The percentage of 'base' that this charge amounts to. Only applicable when 'mode' is 'percentage'.

total_amount.description: The total price for this charge.

unit_amount.description: The price per unit for this charge. Only applicable when 'mode' is 'per_day', 'per_night', 'per_person_per_day', 'per_person_per_night', or 'per_person_per_stay'.

total.description: The total price. Includes all extra charges.

room.description: A signed long number that uniquely identifies an accommodation property room. The full list can be obtained by calling [accommodations/details](#/accommodations/details).

third_party_inventory.description: Boolean value is "true" if the product is facilitated by a Booking.com partner company and "false" otherwise.

occupancy_mismatch.description:
Details any mismatch between the requested occupancy and the product's capacity. 
-When one or more guests cannot be accommodated, the object contains those that can be accommodated (allocated) and those that cannot (unallocated). 
-If all requested guests fit, the object is null.

allocated.description: The guests from the original request that the product can accommodate.

children.description: The ages of the children. Null or absent if no children fit.

unallocated.description: The guests from the original request that could not be accommodated by this product.

children.description: The ages of the children. Null or absent if no children fit.
